player_goal.secondary: Win fights when a nearby enemy threatens valuable loot or the player is already in close danger.
player_goal.fight_policy: Do not hunt unnecessary fights, but commit to winning a forced close-range fight when an enemy comes knocking; judge the decision by whether it protects the loot objective and preserves a realistic escape option.
player_goal.coaching_question: Did this action increase the chance of extracting with the loot, and if the fight was forced, did the player create the safest path to win it?
